name: Chung Chu-Chu
source:
Yu-Qing and Cocoa's classmate. Her father runs a fabric factory as well. Chung is a leader of her gang, and always bullies her peers.

Just like their fathers, Chung and Yu-Qing see each other as a thorn in the flesh.

"I just... don't want to be alone..."

[Edited from [url=http://www.erotes-studio.com/MayJasmine_english/03.html]official website[/url]]
